text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The quarterly budget table shows a total development budget of $1,700,000 across Q1 to Q4 2027.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The development figures by quarter are $450,000, $500,000, $400,000 and $350,000, which sum to $1,700,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q1 2027 | $450,000 | $120,000 | $60,000 | $630,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q2 2027 | $500,000 | $150,000 | $70,000 | $720,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q3 2027 | $400,000 | $100,000 | $60,000 | $560,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q4 2027 | $350,000 | $90,000 | $50,000 | $490,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown says the quarterly figures reflect the originally approved budget and that the total project budget was later adjusted to $2,600,000 for smart TV integration costs.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document states a total approved budget of $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The documents don't state how the $2,600,000 revision is split between development and other categories.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[2,3]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
